description: This file contains unit tests for the command-poll-backoff module, testing functions related to command polling delay calculations, command state tracking, and backoff suggestion logic using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: calculateBackoffMs
methods.description: Calculates the backoff delay in milliseconds based on the attempt count, with specific delays for first three attempts and a capped delay for subsequent attempts.

methods.name: getCommandPollSuggestion
methods.description: Provides a suggested delay before the next command poll based on the command's polling history.

methods.name: pruneStaleCommandPolls
methods.description: Removes polling entries older than a specified maximum age to keep the state current.

methods.name: recordCommandPoll
methods.description: Updates the polling state for a command, incrementing the count on no-output or resetting on new output, and returns the suggested delay.

methods.name: resetCommandPollCount
methods.description: Removes a command's polling record from the tracking state.
